PORT.description: serve: the port the HTTP server listens on.

OSF_DATA.description: serve: the folder of the runs' working folders, runs/<run ID>, and of the harness adapters' session records.

OSF_NOW.description: The current time, like 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z, for the times of runs and stages. Default: the clock.

FOREMAN_API_TOKEN.description: serve: the token that callers of /v1 send as Authorization: Bearer <token>. Required.

FOREMAN_PERSON_KEYS.description: serve: the issuers of person proofs, as name=url pairs of their key sets separated by commas, like console=http://console:8080/.well-known/jwks.json. Set, a signal or a retry whose by names a person needs that person's proof in the header OSF-Person, and the run records the person the proof names (ADR 0151). Unset: the API token names any person, as before.

FOREMAN_FACTORY.description: serve: the factory definition. A path: its folder must be in a Git repository and clean, with every tracked file and every file the foreman reads committed: a run's factory version is its commit (ADR 0110). Or git+<url>#<ref>: the foreman fetches the ref, default the remote's HEAD, into OSF_DATA/factory, reads factory.yaml at the root of that commit, and the commit is the factory version (ADR 0124).

FOREMAN_FACTORY_TOKEN.description: serve: a token for a FOREMAN_FACTORY of git+https://… in a private repository, sent to that URL only as Git's Basic credentials of x-access-token. Never written to a file or a command line (ADR 0142). Unset: Git's own credentials.

FOREMAN_TEMPORAL_ADDRESS.description: serve: the gRPC address of the Temporal server.

FOREMAN_TEMPORAL_NAMESPACE.description: serve: the Temporal namespace of the runs.

FOREMAN_TASK_QUEUE.description: serve: the Temporal task queue of the runs' workflows and activities. The stages that run an agent go to the task queue <queue>-stages (ADR 0160).

FOREMAN_MAX_STAGES.description: serve: how many stages that run an agent this foreman runs at the same time, a whole number of 1 or more, like 2 on one machine. A stage over the limit waits until a running one ends, without a timeout and without using one of its attempts; GET /v1/runs/<id> shows it blocked with waitingSince, and its run running. A stage that only waits takes no place. Each foreman counts its own stages (ADR 0160). The profile and the chart set 2. Unset: no limit.

FOREMAN_HARNESSES.description: serve: a JSON object from harness name to the command line of its adapter. Each command line is a JSON list of the program and its arguments, or a string split at each space. A harness it does not name runs npx -y @opensoftware/harness-<name>@<range> run, at the range under providers.harness (ADR 0110).

FOREMAN_SANDBOXES.description: serve: a JSON object from sandbox adapter name to the command line of the adapter. Each command line is a JSON list of the program and its arguments, or a string split at each space. An adapter it does not name runs npx -y @opensoftware/sandbox-<name>@<range>, at the range under providers.sandbox (ADR 0110). The factory names its adapter under providers.sandbox, or else FOREMAN_SANDBOX picks it.

FOREMAN_SANDBOX.description: serve: the sandbox adapter of a factory that names none under providers.sandbox, like docker in the Compose profile and kubernetes in the Helm chart.

FOREMAN_SANDBOX_OWNER.description: serve: the name of this foreman on its sandbox platform, like the Compose project or the Helm release: up to 63 letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens. Set, each sandbox it creates carries the labels osf.owner=<name> and osf.run=<run ID>, and at its start, before it runs a stage, it destroys the sandboxes with its osf.owner that the adapter of the factory lists (list --label): a foreman that died left them, and a stage that runs again creates a new one (ADR 0158). Give each foreman on one Docker host or in one namespace its own name, and run one foreman per name. It needs a sandbox adapter that takes labels, like sandbox-docker 0.9 or sandbox-kubernetes 0.7. Unset: no labels and no removal at the start.

FOREMAN_REQUIRE_SANDBOX.description: serve: true runs no agent outside a sandbox: a factory with a stage whose agent declares no sandbox is refused like a factory that cannot run, at the start of the server, of a run and of a retry, and its message names each such agent. The Compose profile and the Helm chart set true, so no agent gets the foreman's environment with its tokens. Unset or another value: an agent without a sandbox runs on the foreman's machine.

FOREMAN_FORGES.description: serve: a JSON object from forge adapter name to the command line of the adapter. Each command line is a JSON list of the program and its arguments, or a string split at each space. An adapter it does not name runs npx -y @opensoftware/forge-<name>@<range>, at the range under providers.forge (ADR 0110). The factory names its adapter under providers.forge.

FOREMAN_INFERENCES.description: serve: a JSON object from inference adapter name to the command line of the adapter. Each command line is a JSON list of the program and its arguments, or a string split at each space. An adapter it does not name runs npx -y @opensoftware/inference-<name>@<range>, at the range under providers.inference (ADR 0110). The factory names its adapter under providers.inference.

FOREMAN_SECRETS.description: serve: a JSON object from secrets provider name to the command line of its secrets adapter. Each command line is a JSON list of the program and its arguments, or a string split at each space. An adapter it does not name runs npx -y @opensoftware/secrets-<name>@<range>, at the range under providers.secrets. Before a sandboxed stage, the foreman runs its exists for each of the agent's secrets of that provider; file and env are the sandbox adapter's own (ADR 0139).

OSF_OPENBAO_ADDR.description: serve: OpenBao's address, handed on to the sandbox adapter and the secrets adapter for ref:openbao/ secrets; the foreman reads none of the OSF_OPENBAO_ variables itself.

OSF_OPENBAO_TOKEN.description: serve: the token that may only read the mount, the egress proxy's (ADR 0137), handed on to the sandbox adapter and to the secrets adapter, whose exists asks with it whether a secret has a value.

OSF_OPENBAO_MOUNT.description: serve: the KV version 2 mount of the factory's secrets, handed on to the sandbox adapter and the secrets adapter. Unset, both use secret.

PATH.description: serve: the folders where the foreman finds git, npx for an adapter without a command line, and the programs of the adapter maps.

FOREMAN_FORGE_URL.description: serve: the forge adapter's FORGE_URL, for a factory whose stages have checks. Default: the adapter's own default.

FOREMAN_FORGE_TOKEN.description: serve: the forge adapter's FORGE_TOKEN: a token that may read the pull requests and their checks. Never written to a file.

FOREMAN_CHECK_POLL_MS.description: serve: how long a stage that waits for pending checks waits before it reads them again, in milliseconds.

FOREMAN_CHECK_TIMEOUT_MS.description: serve: how long a stage waits for its checks to succeed, in milliseconds; then it fails with a reason that names each check that did not end (ADR 0106).

FOREMAN_GATE_TIMEOUT_MS.description: serve: how long a stage waits for the decision of its gate, in milliseconds; then the gate expires and the stage is rejected (ADR 0106).

FOREMAN_INFERENCE_RETRY_MS.description: serve: how long the server waits before it starts the factory's inference gateway again after a failed start, in milliseconds. Until a start succeeds, the health check inference fails.

FOREMAN_HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT_MS.description: serve: how long a stage may go without a heartbeat before Temporal runs it again, in milliseconds. A stage heartbeats every FOREMAN_POLL_MS from its start to its end, so keep it several times FOREMAN_POLL_MS. Runs that started before keep their timeout.

FOREMAN_POLL_MS.description: serve: how often a running stage looks for steering messages and a cancel, in milliseconds.

FOREMAN_GATEKEEPER_URL.description: serve: the URL of gatekeeper serve, which a stage with a gate asks for a decision. Required for a factory with gates.

FOREMAN_NATS_URL.description: serve: the NATS server for work.received@v1, work.retry-requested@v1, gate.decided@v1 and doctor.ping@v1 in, and run.started@v1, run.blocked@v1 and run.completed@v1 out. Unset: no events.

OSF_STREAM_MAX_AGE.description: serve, resend: the age after which the stream OSF drops an event, like 7d, 12h, 30m or 90s (ADR 0116). The server adds the stream with it, or sets it on a stream that another module added. Unset: a new stream keeps its events without a limit of age, and an existing one keeps its own. The profile and the chart set 7d.

OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT.description: serve: the base URL of an OTLP/HTTP receiver, like http://phoenix:6006. Set, each run is one trace with a span per stage and one for the run, sent to <url>/v1/traces, and each stage's harness gets the trace in TRACEPARENT (ADR 0087).

OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_ENDPOINT.description: serve: the full URL of the OTLP/HTTP traces endpoint; takes precedence over OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT.

OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS.description: serve: headers for the OTLP receiver as key=value pairs, comma-separated, like a token from a secret store.
